coverage.note: Realized-liquidation totals aggregate the configured venue feeds (okx, bybit, hyperliquid). Binance — the largest venue — geo-blocks its liquidation stream from our infrastructure (no REST fallback), so these figures run below a true all-exchange total. Hyperliquid coverage is COMPLETE and exact: every liquidation fill (market + backstop) across the full HL perp universe, from the node fill stream; the per-event tape is archived as the hl_liquidations backtesting data type.

baseline.window: trailing 1h vs median hourly notional over the prior 7 days (clock hours; empty hours = 0)
baseline.note: Ratios use the exact Hyperliquid liquidation tape for both numerator and denominator — not the venue-merged 1h totals in the row. null = fewer than 24 hours of tape for the coin, a zero 7d median, or backtesting disabled on this box.

grain.note: Each liquidation_usd_* field is a trailing-window level, not a flow: do not sum or difference successive polls. Incremental buckets come from the Hyperliquid fill tape via /api/v1/backtesting/hl-liquidation-bars (Pro).
